'''John Borders''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 6 from San Diego, Ca. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> At DecipherCon 1999 Borders also played [[Young Jedi]], finishing 6th in the YJ Gauntlet, 11th in YJ Qualifier 4 (Constructed) and 20th in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj04_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier 4 (Constructed)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108191000/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj30_3">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_3.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Gauntlet], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105011900/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_3.html Internet Archive]</ref>
